# FG-WEB-0009

| 項目 | 値 |
|---|---|
| HTTP ステータス | 413 |
| 重大度 | info |
| Runbook | なし |
| 発生させるテスト | `oversized_request_body_is_request_too_large` |

## 利用者向けメッセージ

- ja: リクエストの本文が大きすぎます。
- en: The request body is too large.
- id: Isi permintaan terlalu besar.

## 原因 (cause)

A request body exceeded the route's limit (at most 64 KiB for an API route with a JSON body; never above `body_limit_bytes`, 1 MiB). Refused from `Content-Length` before reading, or as soon as the streamed body passes the limit; nothing was loaded or changed. Smart HTTP bodies have their own limits (FG-GIT-0013).

## 調べ方 (diagnosis)

The log event carries `limit_bytes`, `route`, `action` and `declared` (`true` when `Content-Length` already exceeded the limit, `false` when the body grew past it while streaming). The body is never logged.

## 対処 (fix)

Send a smaller body (split the change into several requests). The per-route limits are part of the API description (`x-forge-max-body-bytes` in `Git/docs/api/openapi.json`).
